description: Raise Craft Studio is an independent creative studio focused on game development, 3D art, interactive experiences, and visual storytelling. Our student professional team combines technology and creativity to build innovative projects that address societal challenges, protect the environment, and enhance quality of life on Earth and beyond.
summary:
RED EDEN is a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer for kids ages 7-12. In Unity 6, the player runs a Martian outpost where no choice is free: air, water, power, shielding and food must be balanced. The playable prototype is a gather-to-fabricator loop. The player collects regolith, ferric ore, carbonaceous ore, copper ore and silica, then prints bricks, metal plates, silicate glass and cables. Inventory is the only quantity authority, so a recipe you cannot afford cannot start. That cost is the lesson.

Data is used as scientific basis, not a live feed. DONKI informs radiation and solar-event risk, so shielding costs power. OSDR and RadLab inform real dose and astronaut health. MOXIE and ECLSS inform oxygen and water as processes: ice is logged and tested, never drunk straight. Mars Trek and mission imagery inform the site idea. A.R.E.S. teaches one habit: separate what we know, what we estimate, and what is not sure.
